hints.title: Prefix Mirroring Symmetry
hints.text: A numerical palindrome is determined by mirroring its left half digits onto its right half.

hints.title: Five Finite Candidates
hints.text: Only five palindrome candidates can be closest: prefixes minus 1, same, plus 1 mirrored, along with boundary candidates 10^(L-1) - 1 and 10^L + 1.

hints.title: Candidate Distance Comparison
hints.text: Extract the first ceil(L/2) digits as prefix. Construct palindromes for prefix - 1, prefix, and prefix + 1. Add edge cases 99...9 and 100...001. Filter out the original number, sort by absolute difference, and choose the minimum numerical value on ties.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: number of digits in string n (<= 18)
complexity.notes: Constant candidate generation of 5 mirrored numbers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incrementing or decrementing one by one takes O(10^L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mirroring the prefix identifies closest palindrome candidates in O(1) mathematical cases.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exhaust the 5 palindrome candidates around prefix and boundary transitions.
